style: Hand-drawn 2D cartoon illustration for a YouTube history explainer. Simple stick-figure people with large round plain white heads, black dot eyes, expressive eyebrows, small simple mouths, messy dark hair, thin black stick arms and legs, teal striped hide tunics with a tooth necklace; thick clean black ink outlines, flat bright colors with soft painterly shading, richly detailed painted cartoon backgrounds (caves, savanna, firelight, starry skies). Funny, gentle, not gory. 16:9 widescreen. Absolutely no text, letters, captions or watermark in the image. Compose for a vertical crop: keep the subject and action in the CENTRAL 4:3 area of the 16:9 frame.

shots.p: Extreme close-up of a cream-coloured hollow bird-bone flute with five finger holes glowing in warm firelight, a huge griffon vulture wing silhouette fanned out behind it on a dark cave wall.
shots.line: Someone in the Stone Age made a flute from a vulture's wing bone.

shots.p: The bone flute resting on a mossy rock in a cave mouth while a giant round stone 'age' tablet looms behind it with many tally-mark notches carved round its rim, dusk light pouring in.
shots.line: And it's at least thirty-five thousand years old.

shots.p: Hero shot: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) standing at a cave entrance, arms thrown wide in a big shrug with a curious grin, a firelit camp and mountains at sunset behind.
shots.line: So what did cavemen do for fun?

shots.p: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) slumped on a log with his chin on his fist, eyebrows drooping, a single dry leaf drifting past, empty camp clearing around him, cosy and funny.
shots.line: Meet Moss. He's bored.

shots.p: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) holding a bone flute to his lips, cheeks puffed, tiny painted musical notes floating up in a firelit cave.
shots.line: Surprise one: music.

shots.p: Painted view of a limestone cave mouth in a green wooded valley, cutaway to an excavation pit inside where the bone flute lies in pieces beside a small brush; five finger holes clearly visible.
shots.line: Found in Hohle Fels cave, Germany, it has five finger holes.

shots.p: A friendly modern stick-figure craftsman at a wooden workbench carefully carving a pale bone flute with a small knife, shavings curling, warm lamplight.
shots.line: Experts carved a copy from vulture bone.

shots.p: The craftsman playing the new bone flute while Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) peeks round a rock in amazement, musical notes swirling between them.
shots.line: And yes, it plays.

shots.p: A small stick-figure Stone Age child with a big round white head and teal tunic grinning, fingers spread, standing before a soft clay cave wall covered in wiggly finger lines.
shots.line: Surprise two: kids' doodles.

shots.p: Lamp-lit cave interior with a painted mammoth on the wall; two stick-figure children dragging their fingers in swooping wavy lines through the soft clay beside it, laughing.
shots.line: In Rouffignac cave, France, over thirteen thousand years ago, children dragged fingers through soft clay.

shots.p: Low-angle view up at a cave ceiling covered in looping finger-traced lines, far above two small children who stare up with open mouths.
shots.line: Some lines reach the ceiling.

shots.p: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) holding a delighted small child up on his shoulders so the child can trace swirls on the cave ceiling, a flickering lamp on a rock nearby.
shots.line: Scientists think grown-ups lifted them up.

shots.p: A red-ochre cave wall covered in outlined hand stencils, one tiny child-sized hand outline right in the middle next to big adult ones, warm torchlight.
shots.line: Surprise three: tiny hands.

shots.p: Wide painted cave chamber with rows of red hand stencils; several small ones highlighted by a soft glow, a stick-figure family looking at them proudly.
shots.line: In Spanish caves, maybe a quarter of hand outlines are children's.

shots.p: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) blowing red pigment through a hollow bone tube around a child's small hand pressed flat on the rock, a fine spray mist outlining it.
shots.line: Paint was blown around a hand on the wall.

shots.p: The child pulling their hand away to reveal a perfect small hand outline, beaming, holding the hand up beside it to compare, Moss giving a thumbs up.
shots.line: Like a Stone Age selfie.

shots.p: Night campfire under a big starry sky: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) telling a story with big arm gestures, a ring of wide-eyed stick-figure listeners, sparks rising.
shots.line: Surprise four: stories.

shots.p: Modern-day Kalahari evening: a small group of people in simple clothes sitting around a fire on red sand, one storyteller gesturing, others laughing, acacia silhouettes and stars; respectful, warm, not caricatured.
shots.line: Among Kalahari hunter-gatherers today, most long fireside chats at night are stories.

shots.p: Joyful firelit scene of stick figures clapping and dancing in a circle around the campfire, Moss mid-spin, swirling dust and sparks, glowing night sky.
shots.line: There's singing and dancing too.

shots.p: Split frame: left half a present-day fireside gathering, right half a Stone Age camp around a similar fire, both glowing the same warm orange, the two fires lining up across the middle.
shots.line: It's a modern clue, but a lovely one.

shots.p: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) and a modern kid in a hoodie sitting side by side on a log at a campfire, both grinning, marshmallow stick and bone flute in hand.
shots.line: So Stone Age fun sounds like ours.

shots.p: Three-panel comic: left, a bone flute with musical notes; middle, a cave wall of finger swirls and small hand stencils; right, a storyteller by the fire with listeners leaning in.
shots.line: Music. Messy art. A really good story.

shots.p: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) blowing hard into a bone flute, cheeks bulging, a single wonky squeak note popping out; a nearby owl and a small child covering their ears, laughing.
shots.line: And Moss? Still can't play the flute.

shots.p: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) waving goodbye at the cave mouth at dusk, flute tucked in his tunic, a warm campfire glowing behind him and the first stars coming out.
shots.line: Follow for more Stone Age Stories.
